name: get-into-zone
description: Let Claude use the Get into zone browser extension: Pinterest bulk download, YouTube downloads, Mediamake, Suno and Midjourney.
long_description:
Connects Claude to the Get into zone extension running in your Chrome. Claude can bulk-download Pinterest pins, download YouTube videos, save media to Mediamake, switch on-page saver overlays, upload Suno tracks and drive Midjourney, all in your real browser profile with your sign-ins.

The extension connects to this server over a local WebSocket on 127.0.0.1. In the extension popup, Settings → Let Claude use this extension (MCP) shows Connected to Claude once it is running.

port.title: Port
port.description: Local port the extension connects to. Change it in the extension's Settings too.

extension_id.title: Extension id (optional)
extension_id.description: Accept only this extension id, as shown on chrome://extensions. Leave empty to accept any extension.
